summary: Full backend + frontend testing of WTR-Lab crawler. 13/13 pytest cases pass (root, stats, crawl status, start/pause, settings, proxies CRUD, logs, enumerate, add novel, novel get/list, chapter crawl progress, chapter content with Chinese, export txt/json). Frontend Playwright end-to-end covers Dashboard, global toggle, enumerate, Novels tab add + row + view drawer + Chinese text in raw-viewer, Proxy add/delete, Settings save, Logs. Novel 97812 reached 15 done chapters with Chinese text; status=partial (expected due to Turnstile rate limit).

minor.issue: Turnstile-blocked chapters are being marked status=error and logged as ERROR (41 errors), but crawler.RATE_MARKERS logic intends to keep them as 'pending' silently. Likely because httpx.raise_for_status() throws before the JSON success=false check, so the exception message does not contain 'turnstile'/'challenge'. Consider inspecting response body before raise_for_status, or extending RATE_MARKERS to include HTTP status codes (403/503) / 'forbidden'.

action_items: (Optional) Improve rate-limit detection in crawler.py so Turnstile blocks stay 'pending' instead of 'error'/ERROR log — matches stated design and avoids noisy logs. Not blocking; success criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: wtrlab.get_chapter: r.raise_for_status() runs before checking JSON body. If Turnstile returns non-2xx, HTTPStatusError message lacks 'turnstile' so RATE_MARKERS miss and chapters get status=error. Read body first or check for 403/429 in markers.
server.py exports write file to /app/exports every call — fine for MVP but could accumulate. Consider streaming response instead.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan handlers (FastAPI >=0.93).
crawler.CrawlManager.enumerate_all does NOT await asyncio.create_task, fine; but no lock — concurrent /api/crawl/enumerate can race the running flag (has guard in endpoint though).
seed_data_creation: Novel source_id=97812 (Tokyo Ghoul re Zero) queued and crawled to 15 done chapters with raw Chinese body; test proxies were created and deleted within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_crawler_api.py — reuses public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All flows verified end-to-end including AES-GCM decrypted Chinese content in export files. Turnstile rate limit is expected and does not fail criteria.
